title: Grays, tall whites and Norwegians arrived on Earth at different points in the ice age
summary: Charles Hall tells of Grays, tall whites and Norwegians arrived on Earth at different points in the ice age, about last ice age to present at Earth / Nevada, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Um, consider I'm certain that the grays got here first and they were here before the last ice age and that the tall whites got here second

plain: Charles Hall, who says he lived alongside beings he calls the tall whites in the Nevada desert, told the podcast host Jesse Michels the order in which he believes different beings reached Earth. He is certain the grays, the small grey-skinned beings, came first, before the last ice age. He says the tall whites came second, and a third group he calls the Norwegians came at another point.
